sections.title: 2. Independence and conflicts of interest
paragraphs: The site and all content on it (projects, blog, tools, calculators, models, courses and texts) is made by the author in his own name and at his own expense. Therefore:

Nothing on the site represents the view, policy, data, estimate, recommendation or statement of any employer, company or institution. The author does not speak on their behalf and has no authority to do so. The author's employer has no connection with the site in any way and is not responsible for its content.
Companies, institutions, products and sources are mentioned only to identify public sources and facts. This is no endorsement, recommendation, cooperation or criticism.
The content is not an offer, an advertisement or an invitation to a business relationship in the field of the author's employer, nor is it meant to compete with the employer or its clients.
Work on the site must not affect, and does not affect, the author's performance of his duties to his employer.

Any additional engagement of the author must comply with his duties to his employer, with the law and with trade secrets, with all necessary consents, and is agreed separately, outside this site and its content.

If you believe any content improperly uses confidential information, or gives the impression of speaking on behalf of a company, get in touch through the Contact page. The content will be checked promptly and, if needed, corrected or removed.

sections.title: 3. For information only

It is not a design, a feasibility study, a resource assessment or an expert opinion. It creates no client–adviser relationship and no obligation on the author. Before any decision, consult qualified professionals and the competent authorities.

sections.title: 4. Tools, calculators and models

They are no substitute for design calculations, company procedures, manufacturers' instructions, regulations or the instruction of the responsible person. Do not use them as the only basis for work on wells, work under pressure, work with nitrogen or other safety-critical actions.

Errors, incompleteness and out-of-date data are possible. The user checks the inputs and the results. The geothermal potential models show an order of magnitude from public data; they do not replace a test of the well, an assessment of the workover, a feasibility study or contractors' quotations.

paragraphs: The data come from publicly released sources and are named with the content. Copyright in the sources, images and maps belongs to their owners; the authors and licences are named with the content (for example OpenStreetMap, OpenTopoMap and Wikimedia Commons). problem.heading: Right now, your website may be handing clients to your competitors

items.title: Visitors leave before they see you
items.text: Every extra second on a phone loses visitors before they even see your number — and the ones you paid for are the first to go. The cause is rarely your business: it's a heavy build of themes and plugins, chosen for a site that never needed any of it.

items.title: Customers can't find you
items.text: Thin pages, no local content and technical errors keep you off page one, and AI assistants like ChatGPT don't mention you at all. Whoever they do name gets the call.

items.title: Enquiries go to your competitor
items.text: Forms land in an inbox nobody checks, and the customer has already called someone else by the time you reply.

items.title: You're at someone else's mercy

story.heading: When the ads cost more than they brought in
paragraphs: Meet Daniel, a made-up owner built from situations I see again and again. He runs a tree service company. A homeowner with a storm-damaged tree calls the first company that looks trustworthy — and doesn't wait.

His website opens slowly, Google barely shows it, and the money he puts into ads isn't coming back. Visitors he pays for leave before the page has even loaded — and he never finds out, because nothing tells him.

Then the site is rebuilt: fast pages, SEO from the ground up, every enquiry sent straight to his phone. The pages open instantly and the ad budget finally turns into phone calls. Had he waited another season, the ads would have kept paying for visitors who never called.

items.text: Local SEO, your Google Business Profile and the map, a page for every service and area, and visibility in ChatGPT and AI search.

items.title: Bring them in now
items.text: Google Ads, Facebook and Instagram ads aimed at people looking for exactly your service, with conversion tracking from day one.

items.title: Turn visits into calls
items.text: A fast website or landing page, one-tap phone and WhatsApp, and an AI chat that answers after hours. Every enquiry reaches you instantly.

items.title: Measure what pays
items.text: A monthly report: where calls and enquiries come from, what each one costs, and where to put your next euro.

industries.heading: For businesses that live on calls and enquiries
industries.lead: If your customers look for your service on Google or ask ChatGPT, I can help.

items.title: Trades and home services
items.text: Contractors, installers, repairs, maintenance, cleaning and tree services.

items.title: Hospitality and travel
items.text: Apartments, rooms and villas, with direct bookings instead of commissions.

items.title: Clinics and salons
items.text: Dentists, clinics, beauty salons and hairdressers.

items.title: Local and B2B companies
items.text: Transport, manufacturing and professional services that need a steady flow of enquiries.

final.heading: Whoever shows up first gets the job.
final.text: Customers call the first business they find. Let's make sure it's you. The check of your website and your competitors is free and comes with no obligation.

items.quote: Stojan moved both of my sites off WordPress and onto Astro, and the speed difference was obvious immediately. Every lead now hits my inbox the second someone submits the form — no more checking a dashboard and missing calls.
items.name: Mirko Calić
items.role: Owner, Tree Jaws & Mahalo Tree Service

items.quote: Stojan built our booking site from nothing and set up the Instagram and Facebook ads to go with it. Guests go straight from an ad to a finished reservation, which is exactly what a property our size needed.
items.name: Valentina Jovanović
